entries.reason: Live-verified: the 'Housing, property and land' group on data.nt.gov.au (12 datasets, all reviewed by name) contains only infrastructure planning and public-housing-waitlist datasets — no sales dataset. NT market statistics are commonly sourced from REINT (Real Estate Institute of the Northern Territory), an industry association, excluded per this project's official-government/statutory-authority-only rule (same reasoning applied to VIC's REIV rejection in Sprint 10).
Same portal group reviewed live contains no rental dataset. No official NT government bulk rent source found this pass.
